history.summary: The generic name 'Hanuman Temple' has no single documented referent in Dibrugarh: the city has several Hanuman shrines, including Hanuman Garhi Mandir (West Banshbari), Shri Hanuman Mandir (Naliapool, AT Road), Shree Hanuman Mandir (Joonktollee tea estate) and a Hanuman Mandir near Sadar Thana/Thana Charali. This entry documents the best-reviewed listing, 'Hanuman Temple' at Ttiloi Bari, Chowkidingee (Dibrugarh 786001; 4.3/5 on Justdial), with the identity flagged as AMBIGUOUS. Coordinates are approximate for central Dibrugarh and should be verified on site. No founding history is documented for this shrine.

name: Hanuman Temple
town_description: Dibrugarh is Upper Assam's largest city, known as the 'Tea City of India', set on the south bank of the Brahmaputra. It is a commercial hub of the tea, oil and gas industries and home to Dibrugarh University and the Assam Medical College.

travel.airport: Dibrugarh Airport (Mohanbari, DBR), about 15 km from the city centre
travel.railway: Dibrugarh Town and Dibrugarh (DBRT) railway stations
travel.road: NH-15 and NH-515 connect Dibrugarh to Tinsukia, Jorhat and Guwahati

visitor_information.best_time: October to March, when the weather is cool and dry
visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented; typical Hanuman temples in the city open roughly 6 am-9 pm, verify locally
